WITH pattern_averages AS (
    SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg
    FROM Examination
    WHERE `aCL IgG` IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`
),
pattern_summary AS (
    SELECT pattern, avg_acl_igg,
           AVG(avg_acl_igg) OVER () AS cross_pattern_avg
    FROM pattern_averages
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT pattern, avg_acl_igg, cross_pattern_avg
    FROM pattern_summary
    WHERE avg_acl_igg > cross_pattern_avg
)
SELECT pattern,
       avg_acl_igg,
       avg_acl_igg - cross_pattern_avg AS above_cross_pattern_average,
       avg_acl_igg - AVG(avg_acl_igg) OVER () AS difference_from_above_average_patterns_avg
FROM above_average;
